description_sq:
Astiri eshte zone shume e kerkuar si per banim dhe per investim, duke qene se ka cdo sherbim dhe lehtesi qe i nevojitet perditshmerise. Gjithashtu ka akses te menjehershem me Unazen e madhe, e cila lidhet me zonat kryesore te Tiranes.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje ndertim te vitit 2015, prane Viles L. Pozicionohet ne katin e 4 te pallatit me ashensor . Organizohet si 1+1 me nje tualet dhe ballkon. Orientimi Jug.
Shitet si ne foto dhe eshte gati per t'u banuar.
Prona Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt Hipotekor !
Per me teper informacion apo nje vizite ne prone ju ftoj te kontaktoni!
description_en: Astiri is a highly sought-after area both for residence and investment, since it has every service and convenience needed for everyday life. It also has immediate access to the Great Ring, which connects to the main areas of Tirana. The apartment is located in a building built in 2015, near Villa L. It is located on the 4th floor of the building with an elevator. It is organized as 1+1 with a toilet and balcony. Orientation South. It is sold as in the photo and is ready to be lived in. The property has regular mortgage documentation! For more information or a visit to the property, I invite you to contact me!
